questions.question: What will be the amount of Rs 5,000 after 2 years when the interest is compounded annually at the rate of about 9% per annum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of CI for 2 years = R + R + (R × R) ÷ 100.

⇒ Effective rate = 9 + 9 + (9 × 9) ÷ 100 = 18.81%.

Total Amount = (100% + 18.81%) of Principal = 118.81% of Rs. 5000.

⇒ Amount = (118.81 × 5000) ÷ 100 = Rs. 5940.5.

⇒ Approximating to the nearest whole number, Amount ≈ Rs. 5940.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,940.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 5,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 9% per annum

Time period (n) = 2 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96bcb83e818b12474e0719445ff6f8418670118466917b02130980f941c9893a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 5000 × (1 + 9/100)²

⇒ A = 5000 × (109/100) × (109/100)

⇒ A = 5000 × 1.09 × 1.09

⇒ A = 5000 × 1.1881

⇒ A = 5940.5

⇒ Rounding off to the nearest integer, Amount ≈ Rs. 5940.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,940.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest (CI)

When interest is compounded annually, the accumulated amount is calculated as A = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ and CI = A − P.

Effective Rate Method

For 2 years, the combined effective compound interest rate is directly calculated as (2R + R² ÷ 100)%.

Difference Between CI and SI

For a period of 2 years, the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a given Principal is D = P × (R/100)².

questions.question: According to Newlands' octet law, iron, which resembles ________ and ________ in properties, is placed far away from these elements.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Co and Ni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **According to Newlands' octet law, iron, which resembles Co and Ni in properties, is placed far away from these elements**.
 
• The major** limitations of Newlands' law of octaves** were :
 
 
• It was applicable to only lighter elements having atomic masses up to 40 u, i.e., up to calcium.
 
 
• ​After calcium, the first and the eighth element did not have similar properties.
 
• For example, chromium (Cr) and yttrium (Y) are the first and the eighth element placed in the same column but they have entirely different properties.
 
 
 
• It was assumed that only 63 elements existed in nature and no new elements would be discovered in the future. 
 
 
• But later on, several new elements were discovered whose properties did not fit into the law of octaves.
 
 
 
• Some similar elements have been separated from one another while some dissimilar elements have been placed in the same column.
 
 
• For example,** iron (Fe) resembles cobalt (Co) and nickel (Ni) but has been placed far away from these elements**.
 
• Similarly, cobalt and nickel do not resemble halogens (F, CI, Br) but have been placed in the same column.
 
 
 
• When noble gases were discovered, the properties of the eighth element were no longer similar to the first one. 
 
 
• Actually, now it was the first and the ninth element which has similar properties.

questions.question: By selling 12 watches a shopkeeper makes a profit equal to the selling price of 2 watches. Find his profit in percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of 12 watches = Profit equal to Selling price of 2 watches

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP – CP

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the SP of one watch be Rs. x

Then, Profit = 2x

SP of 12 watches = 12x

Hence, CP = SP – Profit

CP = (12x – 2x)

⇒ CP = 10x

Profit = (12x – 10x)

⇒ 2x

Profit% = (2x/10x × 100)

⇒ 20%

**∴ The required profit is 20%**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 5 days, while B takes 10 days to do the same work. They start the work together but A has to leave the work 4 days before the end of the work. For how many days did A work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 5 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 10 days

A has to leave the work = 4 days before the end of the work

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 5 and 10 is 10

Efficiency of A = (10/5) = 2 units/day

Efficiency of B = (10/10) = 1 unit/day

Total work = 10 days

A has to leave the work 4 days before the end of the work = (10 – 4)

⇒ 6 units

Remaining work = (10 – 6) = 4 units

Time taken by A to complete the remaining work = (4/2) 

⇒ 2 days

∴ The required time taken by A is 2
